body:
42 clue pairs. 24 of them confirmed, 18 still filed as theory. the longest gap runs two years: "karma" graffitied on a wall in "the man" in 2020, and a song called "karma" on midnights in 2022. we mark that one unconfirmed, because it is.

why: Calendar slot 2026-08-15 15:00Z X, the Decode window’s X leg on the same origin-story angle, hook "the number" — a different entry point from Wednesday’s Instagram hero (which told one clue→payoff pair), never a truncation of it. Numbers verified two ways: the live Decode screenshot in PR #1903 shows the 42 CLUES / 24 CONFIRMED / 18 THEORIES / 2yr LONGEST GAP tiles, and lenses.ts contains 42 clue-* entries. The longest-gap pair is clue-the-man-karma-graffiti (plant Feb 2020, "The Man" video graffiti; payoff Oct 2022, "Karma" revealed as a Midnights track), which carries confirmed: false — so the post says unconfirmed rather than overclaiming, which is also the honest-sourcing beat the account should be known for. No media: X image posting has not landed. | Rescheduled 2026-08-12: Joey directed that the next 10 posts each carry a real photograph of Taylor (issue #2031 fallout); this product/feature post now runs after that set. Campaign made story-unique (findPostedDuplicate matches platform+campaign).
